stage_name_zh: 阶段 2：准确表达、一词多义辨析与时序/AI 基础句法（Day 26–50）
learning_objectives_zh: 通过 8 个核心词群（涵盖今日 27 个目标词条）掌握熟悉词汇的学术熟词生义（Polysemy）、一词多义边界、可数/及物性变化与自然搭配。
掌握句子成分精细分析（主、谓、宾、表、定、状、同位语）与核心语法：【G001】五大基本句型（SV, SVO, SVC, SVOO, SVOC）与动词配价边界；【G006】核心介词规约搭配与名/动/形+介词固定结构。
掌握学术表达模式：【EP019】机器学习与时间序列：问题定义、滞后项与符号约定，彻底消除头重脚轻、口语化、过度表达与空洞 AI 套话。
完成 36 道高密度、单点聚焦的实战练习，确保今日每个词条均获得至少 3 次训练（含至少 2 次主动输出）。

grammar_instruction.name: 五大基本句型（SV, SVO, SVC, SVOO, SVOC）与动词配价边界
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 英语句子的核心骨架由谓语动词的及物性与配价决定：不及物动词构成 SV（Evidence accumulates / A problem arose），系动词构成 SVC（The label is meaningless），单及物动词构成 SVO（The team abandoned the approach），双及物动词构成 SVOO，复合宾语动词构成 SVOC（The pronoun makes the final sentence ambiguous）。严禁把不及物动词当及物动词用，或把及物动词误加介词。
rules: 不及物动词（arise, emerge, occur, differ, fluctuate, accumulate, oscillate）后不直接接名词宾语，需用状语或介词短语扩展。
单及物动词（address, discuss, access, affect, investigate, assess, warrant）直接接宾语，禁止按中文习惯误加介词（禁止写 *discuss about, *address to, *access to 作动词）。
SVOC 结构中宾语补足语用形容词或分词说明宾语状态（keep the room temperature constant, make the task easier）。
examples: SV: A problem arose when the data formats changed.
SVO: This paper addresses unequal access to educational resources.
SVC: Without a clear definition, the label is meaningless.
SVOC: The pronoun makes the final sentence ambiguous.
common_errors: 误将不及物动词用于被动或直接加宾语：*A problem was arisen / *differ two groups。
在及物动词后添加冗余介词：*discuss about the findings / *address to the limitation。
SVOC 中误用副词作宾补：*keep the room temperature constantly（应为 constant）。

grammar_instruction.name: 核心介词规约搭配与名/动/形+介词固定结构
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 学术词汇的介词搭配高度固定，且同一词族的名词、动词和形容词常要求不同介词（如 access a database [v.] vs access to services [n.] vs accessible to users [adj.]；emphasise the need [v.] vs place emphasis on [n.]）。
rules: 动词+介词固定搭配：account for, attribute A to B, base A on B, confine A to B, consist of, contribute to, correlate with, decompose A into B, depend on, differ from, disentangle A from B, draw on, focus on, incorporate A into B, rely on, stem from。

名词/形容词+介词精确方向：change in (某指标变化) vs change of (更换)；increase/decrease in (指标) vs of (数值)；attributable to, akin to, amenable to, analogous to, compatible with, consistent with, invariant under, proportional to, superior to, synonymous with。
当 to 为介词时（an approach to, contribute to, be devoted to, prior to, with regard to, amenable to, receptive to, subject to），后接动词必须用动名词（-ing）！
examples: The team developed an approach to handling missing observations.
The simplified model is amenable to analytical treatment.
The distance between two points is invariant under a common translation.
common_errors: 把介词 to 误当成不定式符号：*an approach to handle / *contribute to improve / *be devoted to solve。
介词错配：*superior than（应为 superior to）、*synonymous to（应为 synonymous with）、*attributable for（应为 attributable to）。

grammar_instruction.name: 数值、比例、分位数、矩阵量纲与增减幅度的精确语法
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 定量描述必须严格区分“差值（by）”、“终值（to）”、“比例（proportion/percentage）”、“比值（ratio）”、“百分点（percentage points）”以及“均值（mean）、中位数（median）、众数（mode）、中程数（midrange）”。
rules: 动词 + by + 差值（decreased by 5 units） vs 动词 + to + 终值（decreased to 15）；名词 + of + 变化量（growth of 10%） vs 名词 + in + 变化对象（growth in demand）。
从 20% 升至 25% 是 an increase of 5 percentage points（绝对百分点变化），而相对增幅为 25%（relative percentage change）。
double 表示增至两倍，halve 表示减半（不可写 *halve by half）；midrange 是 (min+max)/2，median 是排序后居中的分位数（0.5 quantile），二者绝不可混同。
examples: The count increased by ten, from twenty to thirty.
A rise from 20% to 25% is five percentage points.
For the values 7, 8, 8, 8, 11 and 12, the midrange is 9.5, whereas the median is 8.
common_errors: 介词 by 与 to 混用导致差值与终值颠倒。
把 percentage point（百分点）与 per cent（百分比）混同。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 机器学习与时间序列：问题定义、滞后项与符号约定
expression_pattern_instruction.template: Let [symbol] denote the observation at time t; we decompose the series into [components] and evaluate predictions over horizon H.
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 用于机器学习与时间序列论文的 Problem Formulation 部分，清晰界定输入历史窗口、滞后项（lagged observations）与预测步长。
examples: Here, N denotes the number of observations, and a lag of one step links the current state to the preceding observation.
Time-series decomposition separates a series into components such as trend, seasonality and remainder.
common_errors: 未说明采样间隔（sampling interval）就直接声称某个 lag 代表固定物理时长。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 客观归属文献观点或档案记录来源
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 准确区分外部文献说法与本文实证判断。
examples: According to the authors, the evaluation uses synthetic sentences.
According to the records, the event began before sunset.
common_errors: *According to me（第一人称严禁使用）。

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：介词 except 的排除用法。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: Every item except the final question was compulsory.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：excess 作前置修饰词或 an excess of；不写 an excessive of。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: Excess energy was stored for later use.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：不及物动词，不写 be existed；原脚注提示与 body of literature 搭配。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: A substantial body of literature exists on this question.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：区别范围扩大与效果改善。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The university plans to expand access to evening classes.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：experience 指经验或经历，不能替代 experiment。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The experiment varied light intensity while holding temperature constant.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：explain sth to sb，不用 explain sb sth。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The report explains the exclusion criteria.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00969 adj.] 明确直接的（例：The instructions include an explicit statement of the recording rules.）；[V00970 adj.] 明确陈述的（例：The protocol includes an explicit statement of the exclusion criteria.） | 本条用法约束：名词explicitness；明确陈述不同于默会惯例。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The instructions include an explicit statement of the recording rules.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00969 adj.] 明确直接的（例：The instructions include an explicit statement of the recording rules.）；[V00970 adj.] 明确陈述的（例：The protocol includes an explicit statement of the exclusion criteria.） | 本条用法约束：explicit 与 implicit 相对；explicitly 是副词。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The protocol includes an explicit statement of the exclusion criteria.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: AI 与优化论文核心及物动词：exploit sparsity / temporal structure 完全是正面/中性的“利用结构特性加速或提效”。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The algorithm exploits the sparsity of the matrix to reduce computational cost.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00979 v.] 探索，考察（例：The interviews explore how residents use the service.）；[V00980 v.] 探索；考察（例：The essay explores differences in rural access.） | 本条用法约束：探索不等于证明或正式检验。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The interviews explore how residents use the service.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00979 v.] 探索，考察（例：The interviews explore how residents use the service.）；[V00980 v.] 探索；考察（例：The essay explores differences in rural access.） | 本条用法约束：explore 并不保证得出确定答案。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The essay explores differences in rural access.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：export X to Y；并不表示改变原始含义。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: We export the validated records to a spreadsheet.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：express uncertainty 不等于否定一切结果。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: Authors can express uncertainty without obscuring their findings.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00984 v.] 延伸；扩大范围（例：The course extends from introductory reading to short academic writing.）；[V00985 v.] 扩展；延长（例：The authors extend the analysis to a second dataset.） | 本条用法约束：原文extends为单数谓语；from/to写明边界。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The course extends from introductory reading to short academic writing.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00984 v.] 延伸；扩大范围（例：The course extends from introductory reading to short academic writing.）；[V00985 v.] 扩展；延长（例：The authors extend the analysis to a second dataset.） | 本条用法约束：extend X to Y；是否可推广结论仍需证据。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The authors extend the analysis to a second dataset.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：extent of；to some extent 表示在某种程度上。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The report examines the extent of missing documentation.
